verifications.claim: Publix stores are closed on Easter Sunday.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Publix stores will be closed on Easter Sunday'; R2: 'Publix stores will be closed on Easter'; R3: 'Publix locations... will not be open on Easter Sunday'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references directly state that Publix stores are closed on Easter Sunday.

verifications.claim: All Publix store locations and pharmacies will be closed on Easter.
verifications.label: CLEAR

verifications.reasoning: References confirm closure of all stores and explicitly pharmacies on Easter.
